repair.title: Children Carry Less Lead
repair.summary: EPA reports U.S. children's median blood lead level fell 96 percent from 1976-1980 to 2017-2020.
repair.why_it_matters: Removing lead from fuel, paint, and products measurably reduced a toxin that harms developing brains.
repair.caveat: No level of lead exposure is safe, and older housing and pipes still create unequal risks.
